newsitem.title: CHINA: BOC gives two machinery firms export credits.
newsitem.headline: BOC gives two machinery firms export credits.

text.p: The Bank of China has provided 600 million yuan in export credits to two machinery import and export companies in southern China to support their exports to southeast Asia, the People's Daily said on Thursday.

The bank has since 1992 extended 1.34 billion yuan in loans to the Yunnan Machinery Import and Export Co and the Yunnan Machinery and Equipment Import and Export Co in southern Yunnan province, the newspaper said.
The bank has long supported Yunnan to expand its mechanical and electrical products market in southeast Asia, it said.
The Yunnan Machinery and Equuipment Import and Export Co now is China's biggest exporter to Burma, the newspaper said but did not give further details.
